#### 1. **Evil Twin Attacks**  
Malicious actors set up a Wi-Fi access point with the same name (SSID) as a legitimate network. Users, unaware it's fake, connect to it. The attacker can then intercept data, perform man-in-the-middle attacks, or steal credentials.

#### 1. **Evil Twin Attacks**  
Malicious actors set up a Wi-Fi access point with the same name (SSID) as a legitimate network. Users, unaware it's fake, connect to it. The attacker can then intercept data, perform man-in-the-middle attacks, or steal credentials.
